prototype_feel_reasons: The white hotspot label overlaps the fisherman’s head, upper body, and fishing activity in both viewports.
On mobile, the horizontally cropped scene hides much of the right-side activity, leaving the visible composition weighted toward the obscured fisherman.
The translucent locked hotspots sit directly over structural details, making the scene feel marked up rather than fully composed.
The scene frame itself is otherwise polished, with consistent rounding, clean masking, and no visible stretching or raw source-image edges.
